mappings.rationale: Commonsense factual and reasoning questions represent everyday conceptual knowledge rather than pure multiple-choice science exams.
Combines retrieval capabilities with structured output to meet the unified 5% target.
Combines schema-following JSON output with retrieval under a unified structured output category.
Tool calling and API JSON generation aligned under retrieval and structured output.
Text transformation, style transfer, and formal drafting tasks are instruction-following tasks, not natural casual conversation.
Summarization, extraction, and creative drafting instructions belong in instruction following.
Reading comprehension and factual answering belong under knowledge and conceptual explanations.
In-depth domain explanations across academic and real-world subjects belong in knowledge and explanations.
Direct scientific and historical explanations belong in knowledge and explanations.
Broadened category name to cover general coding and technical tasks.
Open source software engineering tasks mapped to coding and technical.
Basic Python programming benchmark tasks mapped to coding and technical.
Word problems and multi-step math mapped to reasoning and mathematics.
Grade school math reasoning mapped to reasoning and mathematics.
Maintained under multi-turn dialogue with expanded turn depth.
True multi-turn conversation chains retained under multi-turn dialogue.
Conversational Q&A retained under general conversation.
Interactive conversation pairs retained under general conversation.
Casual greeting and conversational items retained under general conversation.
